plugins.name: ralph-helper
plugins.description: Self-improving, plan-aware orchestrator for ralph-loop. Decomposes a plan into phases, injects unit tests, drives execution with test gating/rollback/regression checks, and learns per project via Obsidian memory + graphify search.

plugins.name: plan-tracker
plugins.description: Plan tracker pane: items of every approved plan, Claude marks them done, opus verifies each mark and audits every turn, leftovers of a plan turn are sent back to Claude on their own.
